metricDefinitions.finalPureReject: Historical shape-only aggregate: finalShape === "pure_reject". It does not require planningIntent === "discuss" and must not be interpreted by itself as the pre-registered product-level final-document pure-reject gate.
metricDefinitions.preRegisteredFinalRejectGate: The retained summary cannot establish this gate from finalShape alone because planningIntent is recorded separately. The C9 no-go does not depend on this aggregate: direct Jev positive accepts were 1/16 (minimum 4) and pure-reject end-to-end p50 was 3227 ms versus 2596 ms for Luna-only.
